contract.room: One permanent company-wide Dispatch Announcements room, separate from shared and private driver conversations.
contract.audience: Snapshot of all active canonical company driver profiles at publication, independent of shifts. Newly added drivers receive subsequent notices. Disabled drivers cannot authenticate.
contract.authority: Existing authenticated driver identity and trusted company viewChat+viewDispatch; staff sendChat additionally required to post. No client role/company/name/audience accepted.
contract.authors: Verified real dispatcher names; unidentified staff cannot publish announcements.
contract.readOnly: Drivers cannot send text/photos, archive, clear, change membership or disable broadcast. Staff also cannot archive/clear or change this fixed audience.
contract.acknowledgement: Explicit per-notice, per-canonical-driver receipt; opening or reading the room does not acknowledge. Retry is idempotent and preserves original acknowledgement time.
contract.storage: dispatch_announcements/<hashed-company-room>/messages and /receipts. Direct client reads/writes are denied by the existing live rules catch-all; no rule deployment. Receipt IDs hash the message/driver tuple.
contract.history: All pending notices remain accessible beyond the ordinary 50-message window. Driver view defaults to pending notices, with acknowledged history available separately.
contract.badges: Driver unread total includes pending notices; count persists until explicit receipt. Preview has a megaphone and !, dismissal only dismisses local preview. Dispatch gets no outgoing badge for announcements.
contract.privacy: Drivers receive only their own acknowledgement status; dispatch sees immutable publication roster with individual pending/acknowledged status.
